entries.title: Matthew 15:1
segments: Then some Scribes and Pharisees from Jerusalem came to Jesus, saying,

entries.title: Matthew 15:2
segments: "Why do your disciples keep transgressing the tradition of the elders by not washing their hands before eating?"

entries.title: Matthew 15:3
segments: "And why do you also keep transgressing the command of God by your tradition?" he asked.

entries.title: Matthew 15:4
segments: "For God said, Honor your father and mother, and, Let him who reviles father or mother be put to death;

entries.title: Matthew 15:5
segments: but you say that whoever tells his father or mother, 'Whatever of mine might have been of service to you is dedicated to God,'

entries.title: Matthew 15:6
segments: is in no way bound to honor his father. Thus do you make void the word of God by your tradition!

entries.title: Matthew 15:7
segments: Hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy concerning you, saying:

entries.title: Matthew 15:8
segments: This is a people that honors me with their lips, But their heart is far from me.

entries.title: Matthew 15:9
segments: In vain do they worship me, While they teach doctrines that are the commands of men."

entries.title: Matthew 15:10
segments: Then Jesus called the people to him and said:

entries.title: Matthew 15:11
segments: "Listen, and pay attention. It is not what goes into a man's mouth that defiles him, but what comes out of it, that defiles the man."

entries.title: Matthew 15:12
segments: Then his disciples came to him and said, "Do you know that the Pharisees were scandalized when they heard that saying?" He replied:

entries.title: Matthew 15:13
segments: "Any plant that my heavenly Father has not planted will be uprooted.

entries.title: Matthew 15:14
segments: "Let them alone. They are blind men leading the blind; and if one blind man leads another, both of them will fall into a ditch."

entries.title: Matthew 15:15
segments: Then Peter said to Jesus, "Explain the parable to us."

entries.title: Matthew 15:16
segments: He answered: "Are even you still without understanding?

entries.title: Matthew 15:17
segments: "Do you not know how all that goes into the mouth passes into the stomach and is afterward evacuated;

entries.title: Matthew 15:18
segments: while what comes out of the mouth comes from the heart--and that is what defiles a man.

entries.title: Matthew 15:19
segments: For out of the heart come forth evil thoughts, murder, adultery, unchastity, theft, perjury, slander.

entries.title: Matthew 15:20
segments: These are the things that defile a man; to eat with unwashed hands does not defile a man."

entries.title: Matthew 15:21
segments: Jesus then left that place, and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon.

entries.title: Matthew 15:22
segments: Behold, there came to him a Canaanite woman of those parts. She wailed loudly, saying: "Pity me, Lord, You Son of David! My daughter is possessed of an evil spirit."

entries.title: Matthew 15:23
segments: But he answered her not a word. Then the disciples came up and kept beseeching him. "Send her away," they said, "because she wails after us."

entries.title: Matthew 15:24
segments: In reply he said, "I was not sent except to the lost sheep of the house of Israel."

entries.title: Matthew 15:25
segments: But the woman came and knelt to him and said, "Lord, do help me."

entries.title: Matthew 15:26
segments: He answered, "It is not seemly to take the children's bread and throw it to the little dogs."

entries.title: Matthew 15:27
segments: "True, Lord," she said, "but even the little dogs eat the crumbs that fall from their master's table."

entries.title: Matthew 15:28
segments: Then Jesus answered her: "O woman, great is your faith. It shall be for you even as you desire." And from that hour her daughter was healed.

entries.title: Matthew 15:29
segments: On leaving that place Jesus went along the shore of the Sea of Galilee; and after climbing a hill, took his seat there.

entries.title: Matthew 15:30
segments: Great crowds came to him, bringing the crippled, the blind, the maimed, the dumb, and many others. They laid them at his feet and he healed them;

entries.title: Matthew 15:31
segments: so that the crowd wondered when they saw the dumb speaking, the cripples walking, and the blind seeing. And they glorified the God of Israel.

entries.title: Matthew 15:32
segments: But Jesus called his disciples to him and said: "My heart yearns over the crowd, for they have been with me now three days, and they have nothing to eat. I am not willing to send them away hungry, for fear they may faint on the road."

entries.title: Matthew 15:33
segments: "In a lonely place like this," asked the disciples. "where can we get bread enough to satisfy such a crowd?"

entries.title: Matthew 15:34
segments: "How many loaves have you?" answered Jesus. They replied, "Seven, and a few small fish.

entries.title: Matthew 15:35
segments: So when he had summoned the crowd, and seated them upon the ground,

entries.title: Matthew 15:36
segments: he took the seven loaves and the fish, and gave thanks, then he broke them and gave them to his disciples, and the disciples to the crowd.

entries.title: Matthew 15:37
segments: And all ate and were satisfied, and of the fragments that remained they gathered seven large basketfuls.

entries.title: Matthew 15:38
segments: And those who ate numbered four thousand, besides the women and children.

entries.title: Matthew 15:39
segments: When he had sent the crowds away, he got into the boat and came into the region of Magadan.
